# Suta-Dhana

> Suta-Dhana ("the wealth of learning", from AN 5.47) offers online Pali (Pāḷi) language courses for people who want to read the Buddha's discourses (suttas) in their original language. Courses are taught in English on Zoom in small groups by Mor Ifrah, a student of Ven. Bhikkhu Bodhi. There is no charge; courses are offered as a service and supported by donations (dāna).

Key facts:
- Beginners' course: Pali grammar, phonology, syntax and vocabulary, always in the service of reading the suttas; readings from the Pali Canon from the first lessons.
- Textbook: A New Course in Reading Pali (Gair & Karunatillake), plus handouts and an online learning platform (learn.sutadhana.com) with a tap-a-word reader, grammar guide and vocabulary review.
- About 30–35 lessons of a little over an hour, twice a week (Saturdays & Tuesdays, 1 PM UTC for the October 2026 group); recordings are provided.
- No previous knowledge of Pali or any Indian language is needed. Groups are kept small.
- Teacher: Mor Ifrah (Israel). Studied with Pariyatti (2016), the Vipassana Research Institute (2017), Pali scholar Sean Kerr (2018), and regularly with Ven. Bhikkhu Bodhi since 2019; has led online Pali study sessions through Pariyatti.org since 2020.
- Contact: moris91@gmail.com
